route_results.reason: Community and indigenous consultation, consent and benefit-sharing lifecycle state is distinct from generic project permits, incidents and workforce state, but the repository has no admitted 2019-2023 contract covering affected-community identity, listed issuers and material subsidiaries, project and territory mapping, consultation and consent versions, objections, accommodations, benefit-sharing obligations, withdrawal, corrections, first-public timing and the complete applicable-market zero/missing denominator.

Accessibility audit, complaint, noncompliance, remediation, certification and penalty reuse the customer-quality, statutory-compliance and testing/certification primitives already frozen by Campaign170, Campaign179 and Campaign221. Selecting a disability class, standard, facility, product or remediation stage would be a subtype rescue.

Launch and payload licensing are regulated-entitlement states, mission scheduling and clearance are operating milestones, anomalies and return to flight are incident-resolution states, and aerospace certification and maintenance are frozen by Campaign218. A launch authority, payload, mission stage or anomaly subtype cannot create an independent mechanism.

Seed-variety testing and registration are product approval states, plant-breeder rights are intellectual-property grant states, and variety or crop production is an agricultural cohort state. Species, right office, product class, testing stage, renewal or expiry is a source-family or cohort variant.

Catch quota and vessel licensing are regulated operating rights, fisheries production is an agricultural or aquaculture cycle, traceability is a supply-chain state, and vessel, manifest, inspection and release are frozen port-cargo lifecycles. Species, fishery, vessel class, quota unit, certification or jurisdiction is not a new primitive.

Campaign205 explicitly freezes interconnection, number portability, service-quality impairment, outage remediation and restoration, while Campaign179 freezes spectrum, route and scarce regulated allocation. Operator, network generation, geography, quality threshold or event stage is an exact mechanism rescue.

Habitat impact and mitigation are environmental externality states, conservation obligations are statutory permit conditions, and biodiversity credits or offsets are certificate issuance, transfer and retirement states. Species, habitat, scheme, vintage, geography or mitigation stage is a subtype rather than an independent mechanism.

decision.reason: Six routes duplicate immutable terminal mechanisms and the only economically distinct route lacks a complete lawful point-in-time source contract. The frozen priority rule therefore stops Campaign280 before formula, direction, source fields, rows or values.
decision.next_safe_work: Campaign281 may freeze a new genuinely independent finite concept-only catalog before targeted inventory. It must not rescue any Campaign280 or earlier route with a current snapshot, incomplete coverage, sibling source, entity role, jurisdiction, field, metric, window, threshold or direction.
